text:
jess: Customer asks if we can deliver a tiny on-prem POC via USB minibundles (airgapped). They need strict monthly maintenance windows and no egress.
omar: What's our minibundle pattern? signed manifest + sbom + model weights + runtime patch?
lia: Exactly. Minibundle = quantized model tar + runtime diff + operator. Signed SPDX SBOM included. Keeps USB <8GB with q8.
jess: Security asked about key custody (HSM vs vendor-signed escrow).
tal: Recommend customer-managed HSM (PKCS#11). We can support vendor-signed if legal escrow approved.
omar: Procurement: is there a special price for minibundle distribution?
lia: Private license covers it; offline support and enhanced SLA are add-ons. Typical quote = one-time provisioning per device + annual support band.
ops-bot: Quick install checklist:
- verify OS deps
- install operator v1.12
- import signed-manifest.json
- ./redwood-install --bundle /path/minibundle.tar.gz --offline
jess: Can we do delta patches instead of full reimage?
tal: Yes. Operator supports chunked deltas referencing previous bundle sha256; chain-of-trust verified via customer root CA.
omar: They want rollback guarantees.
tal: Operator retains N=2 snapshots, auto-fallback if health checks fail in 5m.
lia: Example manifest snippet to share:
{ "bundle":"minibundle-2026-03.tar.gz", "sha256":"abc123...", "components":["runtime:1.12","model:q8-bert"], "signature":"base64..", "upgrade_channel":"quarterly" }
jess: They'll lock cadence to quarterly + emergency hotfixes only. Supported?
tal: Supported. Hotfixes are delta bundles with signed approval tokens.
lia: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers (SBOM, telemetry opt-out, crypto: RSA-2048 + AES-GCM, HSM PKCS#11). Runbook + pricing delta by EOD PST.
omar: I'll ask procurement for flat provisioning budget and loop in legal for escrow options. Thanks. :thumbsup:
